<!-- pr-reviewer: 2c2b4bcbbbd6963a493456d796beae483a734711 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The full test moves to the heavy lane with a correct marker, and keeps both pockets, all shape asserts and the 90 s budget. Only the assert's failure text changed.
- The light twin has the exact name `<full test>_light` and the ignore reason `light lane: ...`. The binary's `#[test]` count goes 2 -> 3. No test was removed.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3141-parallel-lane-heavy.md` records the choice, the reason and what was dropped, and names the rule of decision #2990 that it replaces.

## Results

- Built and tested on the self-hosted runner (macOS): run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44900127398 , merged with main `aa4c785dbd53`. The head check passed (the PR did not move).
- Quick gate on the merged tree: `motion suites: adaptive_troch_parallel` ok, 44 s, 0 failed.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not built locally (the maintainer reserved the local build slots for this review).

## Heavy lanes

- The diff reaches `motion heavy: adaptive_troch_parallel`. The author's run in the PR body is green on this exact head: the full test ok in 15.72 s (budget 90 s) and the light twin ok in 7.58 s, both in release with `--ignored`. This review relies on that result and did not rerun it.
- I read both marker strings against the xtask parsers (`xtask/src/light.rs` MARK, `xtask/src/heavy.rs`): `cargo xtask gate heavy` and `gate light` will find them.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The body says `cargo xtask gate heavy` was not run as a gate command; the same two tests ran with direct cargo calls. The coverage is the same. The first gate-command run will confirm the discovery in practice.
- Law check: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added; no process file, dependency, `CHANGELOG.md` or golden changed; the Gate map header already names `camcraft_motion`, the lowest crate the file imports from; the commit subject is conventional and the body ends `Fixes #3141`.
- The 90 s budget is a wall-time guard in release. The runner was macOS and the author measured on another machine. A loaded runner gave the debug reds; the release margin (15.72 s of 90 s) is wide.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
